title: Common Grace and the Noahic Covenant
subtitle: Genesis 4-11
theme: Sin spreads; God preserves creation for the sake of redemption.
memoryText: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
reviewQuestions: How does the story of Cain and Abel show the nature and spread of sin?
What is the Noahic covenant, and who does it include?
What does the tower of Babel reveal about human nature and God’s purposes?
How does common grace differ from saving grace?
psalmsNote: Psalms 9, 33:10-22, and 36:5-12 on God’s care for the world and his judgment of the nations.
